panels.title: Executive KPIs — Em que hora é mais vantajoso vender energia renovável à rede?

panels.description: Preço médio day-ahead MIBEL Portugal no período selecionado (€/MWh)

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ROUND(AVG(market_price_pt), 2) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: Preço Médio PT (€/MWh)

panels.description: Consumo elétrico médio horário no período selecionado (MWh)

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumo_total), 2) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: Consumo Médio (MWh)

panels.description: Hora UTC (0-23) com maior vantagem de venda: preço alto + consumo baixo = menor competição

targets.rawSQL: WITH hourly AS (SELECT hora, AVG(market_price_pt) AS avg_price, AVG(consumo_total) AS avg_consumo FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY hora), maxes AS (SELECT MAX(avg_price) AS max_price, MAX(avg_consumo) AS max_consumo FROM hourly) SELECT hora AS value FROM (SELECT h.hora, (h.avg_price / m.max_price - h.avg_consumo / m.max_consumo) * 100 AS indice_oportunidade FROM hourly h CROSS JOIN maxes m) t ORDER BY indice_oportunidade DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Melhor Hora para Venda (UTC)

panels.description: Índice máximo de oportunidade: (preço_norm - consumo_norm) × 100. Quanto maior, melhor janela de venda.

targets.rawSQL: WITH hourly AS (SELECT hora, AVG(market_price_pt) AS avg_price, AVG(consumo_total) AS avg_consumo FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY hora), maxes AS (SELECT MAX(avg_price) AS max_price, MAX(avg_consumo) AS max_consumo FROM hourly) SELECT ROUND(MAX((h.avg_price / m.max_price - h.avg_consumo / m.max_consumo) * 100), 1) AS value FROM hourly h CROSS JOIN maxes m

panels.title: Índice Máx Oportunidade (%)

panels.description: Preço máximo day-ahead registado no período (€/MWh)

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ROUND(MAX(market_price_pt), 2) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: Pico de Preço (€/MWh)

panels.description: Horas com preço negativo no período. Exibido como WARN — preços negativos são válidos no mercado MIBEL.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND market_price_pt < 0

panels.title: Horas c/ Preço Negativo (WARN)

panels.description: Horas de atraso entre o registo mais recente na Gold e o momento atual. SLO: < 3h

targets.rawSQL: SELECT date_diff('hour', MAX(ts_utc), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly

panels.title: Freshness (h de atraso)

panels.description: Percentagem de horas Gold face ao mínimo entre Silver consumo e Silver preço. Regra contratual: produto resulta de INNER JOIN.

targets.rawSQL: WITH gold_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_rows FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))), consumo_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS consumo_rows FROM iceberg.silver.consumo_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))), preco_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS preco_rows FROM iceberg.silver.preco_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))) SELECT CAST(ROUND(100.0 * gold_rows / CAST(LEAST(consumo_rows, preco_rows) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM gold_cte, consumo_cte, preco_cte

panels.title: Taxa de Join (%)

panels.description: Estado global do contrato: OK = todos os checks passam; WARN = preços negativos presentes (válido); FAIL = violação de unicidade, nulos ou ranges

targets.rawSQL: WITH checks AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT ts_utc) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok_unicidade, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN consumo_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok_consumo_nulo, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok_preco_nulo, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN hora NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok_hora, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN dia_semana NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok_dia_semana, SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_preco_negativo FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))) SELECT CASE WHEN ok_unicidade = 1 AND ok_consumo_nulo = 1 AND ok_preco_nulo = 1 AND ok_hora = 1 AND ok_dia_semana = 1 THEN CASE WHEN n_preco_negativo > 0 THEN 'WARN' ELSE 'OK' END ELSE 'FAIL' END AS value FROM checks

panels.title: Estado Global do Contrato
Decision Analytics — Perfil de preço e índice de oportunidade

panels.description: Série temporal de consumo e preço. Eixo esquerdo: consumo (MWh); eixo direito: preço (€/MWh).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ts_utc AS time, consumo_total, market_price_pt FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY ts_utc

panels.title: Preço e Consumo ao Longo do Tempo

panels.description: Preço médio por hora UTC do dia. Identifica janelas horárias com preço sistematicamente mais alto.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT LPAD(CAST(hora AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') AS hora, ROUND(AVG(market_price_pt), 2) AS preco_medio_eur_mwh FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY hora ORDER BY hora

panels.title: Preço Médio por Hora UTC (€/MWh)

panels.description: Heatmap de preço médio por hora UTC e dia da semana (0=Seg, 6=Dom). Cor mais intensa = preço mais alto.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT dia_semana, hora, ROUND(AVG(market_price_pt), 2) AS preco_medio_eur_mwh FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY dia_semana, hora ORDER BY dia_semana, hora

panels.title: Heatmap: Preço Médio por Hora × Dia Semana

panels.description: Relação entre consumo total e preço de mercado. Colorido por hora UTC para identificar clusters e outliers.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT consumo_total, market_price_pt, hora FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: Scatter: Consumo vs Preço (cor = hora UTC)

panels.description: Ranking de horas UTC pelo índice de oportunidade de venda. Índice = (preço_norm − consumo_norm) × 100. Maior valor = melhor janela.

targets.rawSQL: WITH hourly AS (SELECT hora, AVG(market_price_pt) AS avg_price, AVG(consumo_total) AS avg_consumo FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY hora), maxes AS (SELECT MAX(avg_price) AS max_price, MAX(avg_consumo) AS max_consumo FROM hourly) SELECT h.hora, ROUND(h.avg_price, 2) AS preco_medio_eur_mwh, ROUND(h.avg_consumo, 2) AS consumo_medio_mwh, ROUND((h.avg_price / m.max_price - h.avg_consumo / m.max_consumo) * 100, 1) AS indice_oportunidade_pct FROM hourly h CROSS JOIN maxes m ORDER BY indice_oportunidade_pct DESC

panels.title: Ranking — Índice de Oportunidade por Hora

panels.description: Médias móveis de 24h de consumo e preço. Suaviza flutuações horárias e revela tendências do dia.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ts_utc AS time, rolling_avg_consumo_24h, rolling_avg_price_24h FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY ts_utc

panels.title: Rolling Averages 24h — Consumo e Preço

panels.description: Consumo total e preço médio agregados por mês. Identifica sazonalidade de médio prazo.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT date_trunc('month', ts_utc) AS time, ROUND(SUM(consumo_total), 2) AS consumo_total_mwh, ROUND(AVG(market_price_pt), 2) AS preco_medio_eur_mwh FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY date_trunc('month', ts_utc) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Agregação Mensal — Consumo e Preço Médio

panels.description: Preço médio por dia da semana (0=Segunda, 6=Domingo). Fins de semana tendem a ter preços diferentes.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT CAST(dia_semana AS VARCHAR) AS dia_semana, ROUND(AVG(market_price_pt), 2) AS preco_medio_eur_mwh FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY dia_semana ORDER BY dia_semana

panels.title: Perfil Semanal de Preço (€/MWh)
Contract & Observability — Qualidade do produto de dados

panels.description: QC-G01: total de registos vs timestamps únicos. Violação indica duplicados na Gold.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_registos, COUNT(DISTINCT ts_utc) AS ts_unicos FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: QC: Unicidade ts_utc

panels.description: QC-G02: percentagem de nulos em consumo_total. SLO: 0%.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN consumo_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: QC: Null Rate Consumo (%)

panels.description: QC-G03: percentagem de nulos em market_price_pt. SLO: 0%.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN market_price_pt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 4) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: QC: Null Rate Preço (%)

panels.description: QC-G04: registos com hora fora do intervalo [0, 23]. SLO: 0.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN hora NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: QC: Horas Inválidas [0-23]

panels.description: QC-G05: registos com dia_semana fora do intervalo [0, 6]. SLO: 0.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dia_semana NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))

panels.title: QC: Dias Semana Inválidos [0-6]

panels.description: QC-G07: registos onde consumo_lag_1h diverge do valor real de 1h atrás (tolerância 0.001 MWh). SLO: 0.

targets.rawSQL: WITH lag_check AS (SELECT ts_utc, consumo_lag_1h, LAG(consumo_total, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ts_utc) AS esperado_lag FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6))) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN consumo_lag_1h IS NOT NULL AND esperado_lag IS NOT NULL AND ABS(consumo_lag_1h - esperado_lag) > 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM lag_check

panels.title: QC: Inconsistências Lag 1h

panels.description: Preços negativos no período. Severidade WARN: válidos no mercado MIBEL (excesso de renováveis). Não representa erro contratual.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_precos_negativos, 'WARN' AS severidade FROM iceberg.gold.dp_energy_market_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND market_price_pt < 0

panels.title: QC: Preços Negativos (WARN — comportamento normal)

panels.description: Total de amostras utilizadas no treino e teste do modelo (n_train + n_test).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT (n_train + n_test) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.ml_metrics_streaming ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Total Amostras ML

panels.description: Coeficiente de determinação do modelo — quanto da variância do target é explicada. 1.0 = ajuste perfeito.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT r2 AS value FROM iceberg.gold.ml_metrics_streaming ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: R² Score

panels.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error — erro médio em percentagem. < 2% = excelente, < 5% = aceitável.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT mape AS value FROM iceberg.gold.ml_metrics_streaming ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: MAPE (%)

panels.description: Mean Absolute Error em MWh — erro médio absoluto nas previsões de carga horária.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT mae AS value FROM iceberg.gold.ml_metrics_streaming ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: MAE (MWh)

panels.description: Root Mean Squared Error em MWh — penaliza mais os erros grandes. Quanto menor, melhor.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT rmse AS value FROM iceberg.gold.ml_metrics_streaming ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: RMSE (MWh)

panels.description: Intervalo de dados utilizado no último treino (ts_train_start → ts_test_end).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT CONCAT(CAST(CAST(train_start AS DATE) AS VARCHAR), ' → ', CAST(CAST(test_end AS DATE) AS VARCHAR)) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.ml_metrics_streaming ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Período de Treino

panels.description: Importância relativa de cada feature no modelo GradientBoostingRegressor (último run).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT rank, feature AS feature_name, importance FROM iceberg.gold.ml_feature_importance_streaming WHERE run_ts = (SELECT MAX(run_ts) FROM iceberg.gold.ml_feature_importance_streaming) ORDER BY rank ASC

panels.title: Top-10 Feature Importance

panels.description: Consumo real da hora atual vs target da hora seguinte. Permite validar visualmente a coerência temporal do lead feature.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ts_utc AS time, consumo_total, consumo_next_hour FROM iceberg.gold.feat_load_forecasting_api_hourly WHERE ts_utc BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime($__from / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AND CAST(from_unixtime($__to / 1000) AS TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY ts_utc

panels.title: Actual vs Next Hour — Consumo (MWh)
